title: Write-Once status analogue through explicit unconnected request
target_operation: Write-Once Value Or Medium Already Written
purpose: Provide a structurally valid explicit-message seed that reaches SendRRData, CPF, and nested CIP parsing while thematically covering the documented general-status name only as a safe analogue.

messages.label: sendrrdata with null-address and unconnected-data items carrying minimal cip request analogue

expected_behavior: The receiver should parse a valid EtherNet/IP SendRRData frame with the documented common CPF item pairing and then process or reject the embedded CIP request according to implementation-specific object/service support.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation command and payload length encoded little-endian
SendRRData uses documented common CPF combination of Null Address Item and Unconnected Data Item
Payload length field matches the 18-byte command-specific body
General-status name is treated as thematic coverage only, not as a claimed response trigger
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed; no vulnerability claim and no exact historical exploit payload. The embedded CIP bytes are a conservative structural analogue because the supplied sources do not provide full wire templates for the named status condition.
